title: B's TacticalPing
body:
## What it does
Quickly create teams and place temporary pings to mark positions for your teammates. Perfect for survival or creative mode. Everything is temporary, so it improves communication anywhere without affecting the world permanently!

## Usage

### Pinging
If you are in a team, **right-click with a compass in hand** to ping. Only your teammates will see your pings. Each player in a team gets a unique color.

### Teams
- `/pt create <name>` — Create your own team.  
- `/pt invite <player>` — Invite a player to your team _(requires leader approval if you’re not the leader)._
- `/pt leave` — Leave your current team.  
- `/pt list` — List all your teammates.

### Config
Find the `config.yml` in the plugin folder and edit it. Then restart the server to apply changes. Simple and easy! ^.^
